eyebrows.text: A study of form, before fragrance.

findings.message: 3 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 10 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "AN OLFACTORY STUDY · COLLECTION 01", "OBSIDIAN · NO. 01", "EAU DE PARFUM · A CONCEPT", "01 — THE ORIGIN").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The title is not readable 1.2s after the page loaded (something lies over it).
findings.fix: Put the headline in the HTML, painted on the first frame; the load sequence only adds arrival and is settled by 1.2s (references/motion.md, "Load sequence in 1.2 seconds"). No preloader, no gate, no waiting for the load event.

findings.message: The margins differ: 72px on the left, 24px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 950px of the width empty: "Find your".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "A presence that remains." (screen 1, 100% hidden); "éclat" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "Formed in silence." (screen 2, 100% hidden); "Remembered in motion." (screen 2, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.
